end.summary:
Practised top, front and side views of rockets, cones, cylinders, cubes, birthday caps and cups.
Correctly matched all 4 views to objects.
Gave 3 unaided correct descriptions out of 4 for solid views.
The same-object/different-position explanation was not yet demonstrated correctly.
Recalled the object instead of only the visible parts once; this was not corrected by the end.
end.parentNote: Reyansh practised describing and matching top, front and side views. They used shape features well for cones, cylinders and cubes, and matched all four views correctly. One mix-up remained: they first included a cup handle because it belongs to the cup, then reconsidered when the handle faced away; at the last example, they still needed to focus only on what the observer can see. At home, place a cup or toy in different positions and ask, “What can you see from this side?”
